limitations: These generated files remain at their original local paths and are excluded from new Git staging.
A checkout contains reports and hashes, not the retained trace/archive bytes. Obtain those bytes separately before independently inspecting traces or replaying archived workspaces.
Hashes establish byte identity only, not authenticity, successful execution or profitability.
Missing, changed or additional local artifacts fail verification; missing bytes are never a pass.
Installed environments and package/browser caches are excluded and are not preserved by this manifest. Historical source/install verification retains its original execution scope.
Candidate-size scan uses ordinary Git visibility and a conservative 8,000,000-byte limit; the supervisor's actual checkpoint is not executed or modified.
The original passing suite/browser/restore receipts retain their historical scope. This repair rechecks bytes/reports, not page interactions or a fresh installation.
